This folder is for the launcher that the server hands out (`GET /zombies-launcher-setup.exe`, `server/launcher.go`). `zombies-launcher.exe` is built from `launcher/` for Windows and put here before the server is built. The server's build then embeds it (`docker/Dockerfile`, stage `server-build`). A server built without the launcher hands out none, and its page shows how to join by hand.
